profiles.name: Test male 5’6" 130 lb
profiles.notes: Test fixture for a slim adult male, 5 ft 6 in and 130 lb, linked to gallery Model 6 (exact-28), the same stated build. GIVEN: height 66 in (5 ft 6 in), weight 130 lb, and a reference pair of slim chinos with a finished waist of 31 in and a total length (outseam) of 35 in. All other body measures are ESTIMATED from slim-male anthropometric proportions consistent with that height, weight and garment. Body waist is 30 in (about 1 in of ease under the 31 in garment waist). Floor inseam is 29.5 in and floor outseam is 39 in. The 35 in garment outseam with a mid-rise front rise of 10.25 in gives a garment inseam of 25.25 in — an ankle-length chino, about 4 in above the floor on this body. (A 29–30 in garment inseam plus a 10–10.5 in rise would describe a full-length pant of about 40 in outseam, which would conflict with the given 35 in length.) Flat garment waist width is 15.5 in (half of the given 31 in circumference).
